name: Extraction Specialist, Aegis Angel and Kyodai — "for as long as you control this creature" holds while you control it
notes: Memory: project_for_as_long_as_you_control_this_creature_2026-10-16. 'That creature can't attack or block for as long as you control this creature' (Extraction Specialist) and 'another target permanent gains indestructible for as long as you control this creature' (Aegis Angel), fired at a target, changed nothing: the condition went to the 'you control a [type]' catch-all, which counted permanents of the subtype 'This'. It is now true while the card the ability came from is on the battlefield under the control of whoever controls the ability. The same trailing 'as long as' on a triggered or activated line had also been filed as the line's condition, so the trigger itself was left out of the card's abilities whenever the board had an effect (it seemed to vanish once fired, and Aegis Angel could not be fired after Extraction Specialist): it is now kept. A second Specialist removed and Kyodai (the same words, with its name) taken by the opponent's Act of Treason show the duration ending.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Llanowar Elves
scryfallData.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

scryfallData.name: Extraction Specialist
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Lifelink
When this creature enters, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature can't attack or block for as long as you control this creature.

scryfallData.name: Aegis Angel
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
When this creature enters, another target permanent gains indestructible for as long as you control this creature. (Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it. A creature with indestructible can't be destroyed by damage.)

scryfallData.name: Act of Treason
scryfallData.oracle_text: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. (It can attack and {T} this turn.)
